entry.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
entry.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer with task curation and prior success retrieval, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA.

entry.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
entry.summary: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value.
